missao.texto: In the Final Journey, Workers of Light: Sowing Love and Hope, Following in the Footsteps of Jesus.

historia.paragrafo1: In Montes Claros, MG, where the lights of hope shone on every corner, an extraordinary group called "Workers of the Last Hour" dedicated their hours to the noble mission of serving love and food to those most in need.
historia.paragrafo2: On cold winter nights or hot summer evenings, they decided to bring comfort not only to empty stomachs, but also to afflicted hearts. Equipped with baskets full of nutritious snacks and homemade meals, the volunteers set out through the city streets in a humble van.
historia.paragrafo3: Along the way, they met homeless people who, despite adversity, maintained grateful smiles. The Workers of the Last Hour offered them hot food, blankets and, most importantly, a human connection that transcended the barriers of indifference.
historia.paragrafo4: The group extended their generosity to hospitals, where people anxiously awaited medical care. In busy waiting rooms, volunteers distributed comforting meals, providing momentary relief for those facing difficult times.
historia.paragrafo5: Among the volunteers, there were collaborators with professional training from the most diverse areas, united by a common purpose: to be the light in the darkness of need. Their touching stories, prayers and encouraging words warmed the hearts of those waiting for food.
historia.paragrafo6: On these memorable nights, they always found lonely and helpless women and men. In addition to feeding them, the Workers of the Last Hour offered them company and listened to their stories. The exchange of experiences brought comfort to both volunteers and those assisted, proving that the act of serving goes beyond simple feeding.
historia.paragrafo7: At the end of the night, the Workers of the Last Hour not only fed hungry bodies, but also fed souls thirsty for compassion. Their commitment was a living testimony that, even in the last hours of the day, it is possible to illuminate lives and spread hope, a snack of love served with a touch of humanity.

fundadora.paragrafo1: Maria Luísa Lourenço is a dedicated spiritist worker, acting as a medium for many years. Her commitment to mediumship led her to create the inspiring project "Workers of the Last Hour".
fundadora.paragrafo2: Her goal is to serve Jesus by welcoming those brothers who find themselves in situations of extreme need, such as homeless people, hospitalized patients and families in precarious conditions. Not limiting herself to offering only material aid, Maria Luísa provides clarification and moral comfort, casting a light of hope on those who find themselves vulnerable and in despair.
fundadora.paragrafo3: Within the Spiritist Center Solar de Jesus, she plays a fundamental role in supporting and coordinating various spiritual tasks, such as spiritual healing passes, lectures and fraternal assistance. Her commitment is not restricted only to the provision of material resources, but extends to spiritual and emotional care, providing a holistic and compassionate approach.
fundadora.paragrafo4: Maria Luísa Lourenço stands out as a true spiritual guide, offering light and comfort to those most in need, building a legacy of compassion and service to the community.

enfermo.title: Prayer for the Sick
enfermo.text:
Lord of Life,
Inexhaustible Source of love and wisdom,
at this moment we place, within Your infinite care,
all those who are experiencing the pains of the body and the afflictions of the soul.

You, who know the subtle mechanisms of existence,
teach us to understand that illness is not punishment,
but an invitation to renewal,
a silent call to introspection,
a blessed opportunity to reassess paths, feelings, and attitudes.

Support, merciful Father, those who lie upon beds of pain,
offering them serenity to endure the difficult hours,
confidence to sustain hope,
and active resignation to transform suffering into learning.

May Your light envelop the sick,
restoring the strength of their bodies,
harmonizing their mental fields,
and pacifying their troubled hearts,
so that, even amid trial,
they may find reasons to give thanks and to move forward.

Inspire healthcare professionals,
that they may be conscious instruments of Your love,
acting with competence, tenderness, and respect,
recognizing, beyond matter,
the sacredness of the spirit who suffers and strives.

Strengthen family members and friends,
granting them emotional balance, patience, and faith,
so that they may serve without discouragement,
love without demanding,
and support without succumbing to weariness.

May every tear shed be gathered as a silent prayer,
every pain be converted into a step toward moral elevation,
and every moment of trial
be transformed into a seed of inner renewal.

Help us, Lord, to understand
that true healing begins in the soul,
when we learn to forgive, to trust, to love, and to hope,
replacing rebellion with conscious acceptance,
fear with faith,
and despondency with the certainty of immortality.

Receive, then, this humble supplication,
and pour upon all the sick
the balm of Your peace,
the hope of Your presence,
and the renewing strength of Your infinite love.

So be it.

desafios.title: Prayer – Challenges, Pain, and Evolution
desafios.text:
Lord of Life,
Eternal Source of wisdom and love,
we place ourselves, in this moment, under the light of Your presence,
to learn to understand the paths of pain,
without rebellion, without despair, without denial.

Teach us to perceive that the challenges that visit us
do not arise by chance,
but are inscribed in the profound script of evolution,
as indispensable lessons for the soul’s maturation.
May we know how to read them with clarity,
welcome them with humility,
and traverse them with serene courage.

When pain reaches our senses and wounds our inner being,
sustain us, Lord,
so that we may not lose ourselves in the shadows of self-pity,
nor linger on the paths of discouragement.
Help us to recognize, in the tear that falls,
the divine dew that waters the hardened soil of the heart,
preparing it for the seed of inner renewal.

Grant us discernment to understand
that suffering is not punishment,
but a blessed opportunity for liberation,
through which old misconceptions dissolve,
forgotten commitments are restored,
and values essential to the harmony of the spirit are renewed.

May we learn to transform pain into a silent teacher,
drawing from it the lesson of forgiveness,
the strength of active resignation,
the courage for change,
and tenderness toward the suffering of others.

Sustain us, Father of infinite goodness,
when challenges accumulate
and hope seems distant,
so that we may not falter in the labor of good,
nor abandon the ideal of growth,
even under the weight of our own imperfections.

Help us to understand
that each step forward, however faltering,
represents a victory over ourselves,
and that every inner overcoming
is a luminous rung in the ascent of evolution.

Clothe us with patience,
to accept time as an ally;
with lucid faith, to trust without fanaticism;
and with active love,
to serve without expecting rewards.

And thus strengthened, Lord,
may we pass through trials
with serenity and hope,
transforming pains into instruments of elevation,
challenges into steps of progress,
and life itself into a constant hymn of gratitude
for the sublime opportunity to evolve.

So be it.

paz.title: Prayer –  Peace Within You, Peace in the World
paz.text:
Lord of Life,
Inexhaustible Source of harmony and love,
we pause, in this moment, under the light of Your presence,
to listen to the inner silence where peace is born
and to understand that the serenity of the world invariably begins
in the intimate sanctuary of each conscience.

Teach us that peace is not the absence of struggle,
but balance in the face of conflict;
it is not an escape from responsibility,
but the maturity to face it with clarity and tenderness;
it is not the denial of pain,
but a profound understanding of its educational value
along the paths of spiritual evolution.

Help us to build, within ourselves,
the peace that arises from conscious acceptance,
from liberating forgiveness,
from humility that recognizes limits,
and from serene trust in Your perfect laws.
May we learn to silence the voices of revolt,
to tame the impulses of intolerance,
and to transform restlessness into prayer,
complaint into learning,
fear into living faith.

Grant us, Lord,
the discernment to perceive
that the violence which afflicts the world
is a reflection of the moral storms
not yet pacified within the depths of human hearts.
Help us to understand that every gesture of kindness,
every elevated thought,
every word of comfort
constitutes a luminous seed
cast upon the fertile soil of a humanity in transformation.

May the peace within us
be grounded in constant vigilance,
in the discipline of feeling,
and in the daily practice of goodness.
May we learn to replace criticism with understanding,
indifference with solidarity,
pride with meekness,
thus becoming conscious instruments
of Your mercy.

Sustain us, Father,
in the moments when discouragement visits us,
reminding us that every shadow is transient
and that light, though veiled, is never extinguished.
May hope guide our steps,
and love inspire our decisions,
so that we may be builders of peace
wherever we may be.

And thus, radiating the peace we receive from You,
may we cooperate in the building
of a more just, fraternal, and compassionate world,
where hearts, reconciled with themselves,
learn to live in harmony with one another.

Grant, Lord,
that the peace within us may be the dawn
of peace in the world.

So be it.
